evals.prompt: Verify a local React + FastAPI app's login and form validation flows with Playwright.
evals.expected_output: Use scripts/with_server.py for managed startup/cleanup, capture console/page/network errors, use semantic role locators, capture and visually inspect screenshots, and stop managed servers.
expectations: Starts only project-required servers and cleans them up on exit
Captures console errors and failed network requests
Uses semantic role/label locators and visually inspects screenshots

evals.prompt: Test responsive layout and keyboard focus visibility at 375px and 1280px viewports.

expectations: Closes browser contexts in finally blocks
